ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS.name: ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS
ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS.description: Inquiries regarding the shipping status, transit delay, ETA, or carrier tracking of an in-flight order.
ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS.scope_inclusions: Late packages, stuck tracking updates, dispatch ETA questions, carrier delivery delays.
ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS.scope_exclusions: Package marked delivered but not found (classified under PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING).
ORDER_TRACKING_AND_DELIVERY_STATUS.real_example: Hey @AmazonHelp my order was supposed to be delivered yesterday by 8pm but the tracker hasn't updated in two days. Where is it?

PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING.name: PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING
PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING.description: Reports that a shipment was marked delivered but never received, arrived damaged, or had items missing from the box.
PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING.scope_inclusions: Porch theft, delivered to wrong address, broken item upon arrival, empty box, wrong item inside.
PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING.scope_exclusions: Standard return requests for working items customer no longer wants (classified under REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST).
PACKAGE_DAMAGED_OR_MISSING.real_example: Tracking says handed to resident at 3 PM but nobody was home and my porch is empty! Need this resolved immediately.

REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST.name: REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST
REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST.description: Requests to initiate a return, inquiries regarding delayed refund processing, or return pickup scheduling.
REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST.scope_inclusions: Return drop-off questions, return shipping label issues, refund not credited back to bank account.
REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST.scope_exclusions: Unauthorized charges or fraud (classified under ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY).
REFUND_AND_RETURN_REQUEST.real_example: I returned the defective monitor a week ago and drop-off was scanned, but I still have not received my refund to my card.

SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES.name: SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES
SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES.description: Issues related to Amazon Prime memberships, Prime Video streaming, Kindle, Audible, or Amazon Music services.
SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES.scope_inclusions: Prime auto-renewal cancellations, Prime Video playback errors, Kindle book download failures.
SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES.scope_exclusions: Physical hardware device malfunctions (e.g., Echo speaker broken).
SUBSCRIPTION_AND_DIGITAL_SERVICES.real_example: I was charged $14.99 for Prime this morning even though I cancelled auto-renew last week. Please cancel and refund.

ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY.name: ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY
ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY.description: Urgent account credential issues, 2-factor authentication lockouts, OTP non-delivery, or suspected account compromise.
ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY.scope_inclusions: OTP not arriving on phone, locked out due to suspicious activity, unrecognized login attempts, hacked accounts.
ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY.scope_exclusions: Forgotten password where self-service reset works normally without error.
ACCOUNT_ACCESS_AND_SECURITY.real_example: I'm locked out of my Amazon account and the 2FA SMS code is not sending to my mobile number. Cannot log in to check orders.

PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING.name: PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING
PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING.description: Billing anomalies, double charges, payment method declines, gift card redemption errors, or promotional code failures.
PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING.scope_inclusions: Payment declined despite valid card, gift card balance not applying, checkout promo code not recognized.
PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING.scope_exclusions: General price matching requests on items already purchased weeks ago.
PAYMENT_AND_PROMOTIONAL_PRICING.real_example: Tried checking out with promo code SAVE20 but it says invalid code even though the promotion runs until tomorrow.

PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_AND_INQUIRY.name: PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_AND_INQUIRY
PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_AND_INQUIRY.description: Pre-purchase questions about item stock availability, restocking dates, technical specifications, or third-party sellers.
PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_AND_INQUIRY.scope_inclusions: Restock timelines, compatibility inquiries, third-party seller legitimacy checks.
PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_AND_INQUIRY.real_example: When will the Sony WH-1000XM5 in silver be back in stock directly from Amazon? It has been sold out for two weeks.

SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK.name: SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK
SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK.description: Escalated complaints regarding poor agent interactions on phone/chat, delivery driver misconduct, or overall service dissatisfaction.
SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK.scope_inclusions: Phone support agent hung up, delivery driver drove on lawn/misbehaved, recurring bad customer service.
SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK.scope_exclusions: Specific shipping delay without explicit complaint about representative conduct.
SERVICE_COMPLAINT_AND_AGENT_FEEDBACK.real_example: Your chat representative just disconnected the chat on me mid-conversation after making me wait 45 minutes. Absolutely disgraceful.
